hooks.name: Lint Python on save
hooks.description: Reports ruff findings (rules in ruff.toml) for the saved file only, or a stdlib syntax check when ruff isn't installed. Prints nothing when clean, so a clean save costs no tokens. It doesn't auto-fix, because rewriting the file mid-edit breaks the agent's next edit. On Windows, if `python` isn't on PATH in Kiro's shell, change it to `py -3`.

hooks.name: Analyze PowerShell on save
hooks.description: Reports parse errors for the saved .ps1 file using Windows PowerShell 5.1 when available (pwsh otherwise), plus PSScriptAnalyzer findings if that module is installed. This is a fast per-file check; tools/Test-PowerShellSyntax.ps1 and the CLM guardrails in test_guardrails.py are still the real verification.
